about_the_game:
🍔 Diner Simulator — Welcome to Your Dream (and Maybe a Bit of a Nightmare)
You finally did it — your very own cozy little diner is open for business! The locals are lining up, hungry and curious. But are you ready to handle everything yourself?

In Diner Simulator, you're not just the chef — you're the server, the cleaner, the stock manager, and the heart of the whole operation. Cook meals, serve guests, keep your supplies in check, and make sure the place stays squeaky clean before the next lunch rush hits.

Feeling overwhelmed? Call in reinforcements! In online co-op (up to 4 players), kitchen chaos turns into hilarious teamwork. Divide the duties, create your own strategies, and see who cracks under pressure first.

Will your humble café grow into a restaurant empire... or will it all go up in smoke? The grill is hot — time to find out.

🧾 Features:
🍳 Solo or Co-Op Mayhem – Run the entire diner by yourself or team up with friends for a co-op experience full of laughter, yelling, and last-second saves.

👨‍🍳 Cook Like a Pro – Master dozens of recipes, customize your menu, and serve everything from greasy breakfasts to gourmet dishes — all under pressure.

🧼 Keep It Clean, Keep It Running – Manage supplies, clean up messes, fix broken gear, and do all the behind-the-scenes work that keeps the place from falling apart.

🏗️ Upgrade & Personalize – Expand your diner, decorate the space, add new appliances, and build the ultimate neighborhood hotspot.

🔥 Hilarious Kitchen Chaos – Slip-ups, shouting, grease fires, picky customers — experience the true madness of running a diner where anything (and everything) can go wrong.

Whether you’re chasing five-star reviews or just trying to keep the toast from burning — Diner Simulator is your ticket to delicious disaster.
Ready to take the heat?

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or above

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Direct X compatible
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
